messages:
hana: Quick, very unofficial poll  what's your go-to 30min unwind soundtrack + 5-10 min bedtime short reading? trying to assemble a 'weekday reset' kit.
omar: For soundtrack: late-night radio / old BBC ambient shows. Add a little Miles Davis for warmth. For reading: a 5min verse of Mary Oliver.
lucy: 30min mix: analog synths -> lo-fi piano. bedtime short: 'The Night Ocean' (flash fiction) works nicely.
pat: I cheat and do an instrumental movie score loop (Thomas Newman), 20-30min repeat. reading: 6 pages from a cozy mystery. low stakes.
hana: @soundbot any playlist match for "analog synths -> lo-fi piano"?
soundbot: Suggestion: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5example (analog synths, downtempo piano, vinyl textures) :headphones:
jonah: also try mixing in a short field recording (rain on metal) for the first 5 minutes then fade into music. strangely grounding.
omar: idea: pack these as three options: "Rain + Piano" (short), "Warm Jazz" (30m), "Cinematic Repeat" (loop). people can pick per night.
lucy: @hana you could do a tiny DM-based distribution weekly: 1 track + 1 reading snippet. low friction.
hana: love that. small ask: who wants to be a subscriber for week1?
pat: in.
jonah: me.
omar: me as well.
soundbot: Subscriptions recorded: hana_weekly_reset (3 subscribers). Reminder scheduled: 1770098700 (1 week from now).
hana: sweet! i'll post the first mini-set monday evening. will attach Spotify links and a tiny text excerpt. maybe theme each week (rain, city hum, late-summer).
lucy: brilliant. tiny ritual incoming. thanks team. :sparkles:
hana: also accepting volunteer curators if anyone wants to swap weeks. :raised_hands:
pat: i can take week3 and do a film-score focus.
jonah: i'll do a field-recordings week.
hana: perfect. will DM details. this thread made my evening more organized than any to-do list ever has.
omar: same. also please include a no-ads policy in spirit. :grimacing:
hana: noted. short, ad-free vibes only.
